Catalogue images are studio renders on white.
Shelf images are not.

Measure gallery quality BEFORE promising accuracy,
and add in-store gallery images per SKU —
the gallery can mix sources.

Tutorial advice: ~200 annotated images per class,
COCO format, and RandomErasing augmentation
when occlusion is severe (i.e. a real shelf)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="250" width="420" x="40" y="470" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="inf" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="INFERENCE (edge box or store tablet)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="410" width="480" x="520" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f1" parent="inf" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="1 · mainbody detection
PicoDet / PP-YOLOE+ (PaddleDetection)
class-agnostic crops — PicoDet TARGETS CPU/mobile,
which is why the cheap edge box works" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="440" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f2" parent="inf" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="2 · feature extraction — PP-ShiTuV2 → embedding per crop" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="440" x="20" y="128" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f3" parent="inf" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="3 · vector retrieval — top-k from the gallery + threshold" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="42" width="440" x="20" y="182" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f4" parent="inf" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="4 · THREE-WAY DECISION
high confidence → SKU identified
low / ambiguous → top-3 + human confirm (staff or shopper tap)
below floor → "unknown item" — NEVER guess" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="440" x="20" y="236" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f5" parent="inf" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="Report PRECISION AT THE AUTO-ACCEPT THRESHOLD,
not top-1 accuracy. The operating point is the deliverable." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="440" x="20" y="328" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bar" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=middle;fontStyle=1" value="Barcode still wins when present.
A barcode is an exact key; an embedding is a similarity.
Vision is the FALLBACK and the AUDIT tool, not a
replacement for barcodes. compliance deviation → task" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="340" x="20" y="166" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c4" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" value="V01 Scan &amp; Go
damaged/missing barcode → top-3 → confirm" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="52" width="340" x="20" y="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c5" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;" value="receiving / inventory count" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="340" x="20" y="294" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="loop" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="THE LOOP NOTHING ELSE CLOSES

V04 RT-DETRv2 → "is there a GAP on this shelf?"
C05 PP-ShiTuV2 → "WHICH SKU is this?"
I03 optimizer → "which SKU SHOULD be here?"

optimizer produces a planogram
 → the camera reports what is actually there
 → deviations become tasks

Both vision models are Apache-2.0 / MIT.
They solve different halves and compose." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="250" width="380" x="1060" y="470" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="repos" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f9f9f9;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="Repos &amp; data

PaddlePaddle/PaddleClas — Apache-2.0
 PP-ShiTuV2, Recall@1 +~8 pts over V1
PaddlePaddle/PaddleDetection — Apache-2.0
 PicoDet, PP-YOLOE+
ColugoMum/Goods_Recognition
 full training + deployment walkthrough

Bootstrap datasets:
 SKU-110K dense shelf detection
 RP2K · Products-10K retrieval gallery

→ prove the pipeline on public data BEFORE
 collecting a single in-store image." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="300" width="270" x="1490" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lic" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" value="Licence position

PaddleClas Apache-2.0
PaddleDetection Apache-2.0
RT-DETRv2 Apache-2.0
ByteTrack MIT

No AGPL. No non-commercial weights.
Put it on a slide." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="270" x="1490" y="430" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="demo" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;dashed=1;" value="The demo moment: create a brand-new SKU on stage, add three photos, index it, photograph it on the shelf — recognised immediately, no training run. Time it.
Known limit to state honestly: visually near-identical variants (same product, 400g vs 800g) should return the SPU GROUP and let a human pick the variant. THE MOST LIKELY CAUSE OF DISAPPOINTMENT
Catalogue images are studio renders on white.
Shelf images are not.
Measure gallery quality BEFORE promising accuracy,
and add in-store gallery images per SKU —
the gallery can mix sources.
Tutorial advice: ~200 annotated images per class,
COCO format, and RandomErasing augmentation
when occlusion is severe (i.e. a real shelf).

div.div:
THE LOOP NOTHING ELSE CLOSES
V04 RT-DETRv2 → "is there a GAP on this shelf?"
C05 PP-ShiTuV2 → "WHICH SKU is this?"
I03 optimizer → "which SKU SHOULD be here?"
optimizer produces a planogram
→ the camera reports what is actually there
→ deviations become tasks
Both vision models are Apache-2.0 / MIT.
They solve different halves and compose.

div.div:
The demo moment: create a brand-new SKU on stage, add three photos, index it, photograph it on the shelf — recognised immediately, no training run. Time it.
Known limit to state honestly: visually near-identical variants (same product, 400g vs 800g) should return the SPU GROUP and let a human pick the variant. SpuController / SkuGroupController already model that.
